description: Salvager (Uncommon perk) in House of Pips: Once per round, replace a drawn bone worth at least 10 pips.
html:
Perks › Uncommon

Salvager

Uncommon perk · Boneyard

Once per round, replace a drawn bone worth at least 10 pips.

In-game card text

How it works

When you draw from the boneyard and pick a heavy bone (10 or more pips), Salvager lets you pick one more face-down bone, turns them over, and you keep the one you want.

  • Each copy covers one heavy draw per hand.
  • It only triggers when the boneyard still has another bone to offer.
  • The heavy bones are 4-6, 5-5, 5-6 and 6-6.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeBoneyard
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
